China Medical System Holdings Limited (the “Company”, together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”) is pleased to announce that its subsidiary, Dermavon Holdings Limited (“Dermavon”, an innovative pharmaceutical company specialized in skin health which is applying for an independent listing on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited, please refer to the announcement of the Company dated 22 April 2025 for details), has obtained the relevant licensing rights to the innovative oral JAK1 inhibitor povorcitinib (proposed English generic name: Povorcitinib Phosphate Tablets) (“povorcitinib” or the “Product”), which has been included in the list of Breakthrough Therapeutic Drugs by the Center for Drug Evaluation of the National Medical Products Administration of the People’s Republic of China (“NMPA”), with a proposed indication for adult patients with non-segmental vitiligo.
